newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields up, 6-,9-mo yields down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields up, 6-,9-mo yields down.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury rose to 48.41 percent from 48.36 percent at the last sale on December 17, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 7.95 million UAH 10.43 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.09 million UAH 9.31 million UAH
The central bank sold 79,505 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 39,544 were competitive and 39,961 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 24.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.30 percent from 59.40 percent at the last sale on December 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 20.66 million UAH 22.64 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.94 million UAH 17.46 million UAH
The central bank sold 206,584 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 176,298 were competitive and 30,286 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 24.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 60.89 percent from 61.45 percent at the last sale on December 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 6.48 million UAH 22,260 hryvnia
The central bank sold 94,330 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 78,900 were competitive and 15,430 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for December 24.
